title: Privacy notice
subtitle: How the Raízes do Nordeste network handles personal data on the web channel.
purpose: We use the data to create the account, authenticate access, record orders, run loyalty and locate the serving unit. We do not use the data for third-party ads.
legal: Account creation depends on the explicit consent in this notice (LGPD art. 7, I). Orders and franchise operations also rely on performing the consumer contract (art. 7, V).
data: On the account: name, email, phone and password (the password stays in Supabase Auth). On the client record: CPF, birth date, address, city, state, ZIP and preferred unit. Orders, mocked payments and support tickets stay linked to that account.
retention: The account stays while it is active. Orders and audit logs stay as long as the network needs them and the law requires. This version has no automatic deletion deadline.
rights: You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction and information about sharing. Use the email below to exercise these rights.
contact: Privacy — Raízes do Nordeste. Academic quality-track channel. Email: privacidade@raizes.local
limitsTitle: What this version still does not store
limits: Checking the box does not create a database row. There is no persisted policy version and no separate promotional opt-in.
